scenario.description: A DevOps team needs to configure a new microservice deployment on a Kubernetes cluster. The team must ensure the deployment adheres to specific resource limits, an exact image version, and a strict health check interval. The team consists of a Lead DevOps Engineer, a Kubernetes Specialist, and a Security Engineer. The Lead DevOps Engineer provides the initial requirements, the Kubernetes Specialist implements the deployment, and the Security Engineer reviews for compliance and security best practices. All agents need to communicate directly and frequently to ensure the precise resource limits, image version, and health check interval are consistently applied throughout the configuration process. This easy structural-complexity task focuses on confirming that the exact numerical and version constraints are accurately propagated and maintained across the fully connected team over 6 turns, ensuring no details are lost or misinterpreted in the rapid exchange of information.

---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: my-app-deployment
  labels:
    app: my-app
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: my-app
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: my-app
      annotations:
        prometheus.io/scrape: "true"
        prometheus.io/port: "8080"
        prometheus.io/path: "/metrics"
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: app-runner
      containers:
      - name: my-app-container
        image: my-app:v2.3.1-beta
        resources:
          limits:
            cpu: "1.25"
          requests:
            memory: "512.75Mi"
        volumeMounts:
        - name: data-volume
          mountPath: /data
        livenessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /healthz
            port: 8080
          initialDelaySeconds: 15
          periodSeconds: 15
          timeoutSeconds: 5
          failureThreshold: 3
          successThreshold: 1
      volumes:
      - name: data-volume
        emptyDir: {}
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: my-app-service
  labels:
    app: my-app
spec:
  selector:
    app: my-app
  ports:
  - protocol: TCP
    port: 8080
    targetPort: 8080
---
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: my-app-egress-policy
  namespace: default
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: my-app
  policyTypes:
  - Egress
  egress:
  - to:
    - podSelector: {}
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 8080
